about: The collecta of the formulary “Mass of the Easter Vigil” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Who dost illumine this most sacred night with the glory of the Lord's resurrection, preserve in the new offspring of Thy household the spirit of adoption which Thou hast given, that, renewed in body and mind, they may render unto Thee pure service. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
